notes: v471 — the signal rules are OUT of the app. Until today, anyone could open the published file and read the exact triggers and thresholds behind every signal. They now live only on our Cloudflare worker: the app sends the ordinary chart maths (moving averages, RSI, volume ratios) and the server sends back which signals fired. The six newest signals — 52-week High, Golden Cross, RSI Recovery, Volatility Squeeze, Rel-Strength Leader, News+Volume — are no longer defined in the file in any form. There is deliberately NO on-device fallback, because keeping one would mean keeping the thresholds published: if the server can't be reached the tiles stay blank and say why, and the auto-pilot stands aside rather than guessing. A missing signal, never a wrong one. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
